verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents a Public API and a CLI with a local REST mode, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes API versioning or any deprecation policy. Package release numbers for the CLI and MCP server are software versions, not a versioned-API contract with documented deprecation terms, and no OpenAPI spec was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
